ideas.pitch: A platform built specifically for B.Tech students to track their syllabus coverage, map missing industry skills against ongoing coursework, and auto-generate personalized study sprints.
ideas.title: B.Tech Academic Progression and Skill Gap Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the strict B.Tech student demographic requirement of the hackathon directly with immediate utility for university peers and faculty judges.

ideas.pitch: A local static analysis tool designed for hackathons and coding contests to run lightweight syntax tree comparison and AST structural hashing before final submission.
ideas.title: Plagiarism Aware Code Submission Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly references the hackathon's explicit guideline regarding plagiarism detection, making it an amusing and practical utility for organizers and participants alike.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first progressive web app designed to help participants navigate the VNR VJIET campus for Round 2, featuring real-time schedule countdowns and room finders.
ideas.title: VNR VJIET Campus Venue and Event Navigation Utility
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the on-site logistics team and judges at the VNR VJIET campus by solving real physical navigation friction during the 13-hour final round.

ideas.pitch: A strategy dashboard for competitive programmers that simulates 90-minute online coding rounds, tracking submission timestamp bottlenecks to optimize tie-breaker performance.
ideas.title: Coding Round Time Management and Tie-Breaker Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the specific contest rules—specifically the 90-minute format and submission time tie-breaker mechanism—to provide a competitive advantage to users.

ideas.pitch: A verification portal that validates student B.Tech enrollment status, prevents multi-team registration conflicts, and streamlines check-in for hybrid hackathon rounds.
ideas.title: Automated Team Registration and Eligibility Checker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the specific eligibility constraints and disqualification risks mentioned in the contest rules with a clean administrative tool.
